effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Move_Masked_Edge_Reveal_Down_Out
effectgroup.description: Out half of Masked_Edge_Reveal_Down: the layer slides back into the invisible line it came from (15 frames, expo ease-in). Razor 15 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden).
